plan.status: CPU registered; root review required before GPU launch
plan.column_order: Alphabetical stable predictor-column names; identical across new policies/profiles; excludes original target-derived feature order. Original B references retain their original frozen design.
plan.row_order: Train/query SHA256(pid), then pid tie-break; IDs never predictors. Preserve all query PIDs; exact identical-input predictions receive one average score.
plan.training_target: Require observed finite ordinals1..h with season_end<=Y-1; never fill missing WAR with zero. Sum observed WAR, clip[-40,40], then average-tied cohort Gaussianrank using ONLY admitted training rows: ndtri(clip((rank-0.5)/n,.01,.99)).
plan.evaluation: Always report BOTH prespecified metrics: full-query legacy missing-to-zero truth, and fixed observed-truth mask requiring every ordinal1..k by2018. Same full query prediction population for both; paired original B comparisons on the identical mask. Never choose whichever score is better. Neither is a certified complete-population benchmark.
limitations: Observed-label admission and observed-truth masks may select survivors; source-gap is not proven career zero
Reused pre2019 development folds; no heldout2019+ data or scores
plan.reference_gate: Three exact original B raw/canonical/score/audit replays before interpretation; also score those fixed predictions on the registered observed-truth masks.
